Anatoki Forks Hut - Waingaro Forks Hut: 7-10 hr
Waingaro Forks Hut - road end: 6-7 hr (18 km)
From the car park follow the markers and ford Go Ahead Creek before sidling up the hill to join onto an old benched gold miner’s track.
Uruwhenua Road is reached and a further 3 kilometres will take you back to the State Highway near Lindsay’s Bridge.

doubts: Start ref F1 (where Anatoki Track meets Anatoki Track Road) is chosen over the adjacent F2 (an unnamed track on the same road); the text names only 'a small car park and intentions shelter' 3 km up the road off Kotinga Road. The end at Uruwhenua Road has no road-end feature; the 'Uruwhenua' place entry (T17) was not used because it is not clearly the track's end. The Stanley River has three entries and none is clearly the point reached after the saddle, so it is left without a ref. Soper Shelter is at the western end of Lake Stanley on the way, but the text does not say it has bunks, so it is not listed as a hut. The page mentions three restored huts from the 1930s without naming them; Tin Hut is 60 m below the track and Riordans Hut 30 min off it.
